extraFacts.fact: The working load limit (WLL) is the maximum load a lifting component is rated to carry in service; proof load and minimum breaking load are test figures and are never used as working limits.

faqs.q: What is the Bow Nut — BS 3974 and what is it used for?
faqs.a: Eye bolts and eye nuts give a threaded lifting point on machinery, moulds and equipment. The Bow Nut — BS 3974 follows BS 3974 and is made in high tensile steel, listed in 12 sizes with size range M8 to M42 and working load limit 230 to 7,400 kg.

faqs.q: How are the Indus part numbers for the Bow Nut — BS 3974 structured?
faqs.a: IH-LR-EB-BNB3974 is the base part number for the Bow Nut — BS 3974, and each size adds a suffix: IH-LR-EB-BNB3974-M8 is the M8 row and IH-LR-EB-BNB3974-M42 the M42 row. Every size has its own Indus part number in the size table.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Bow Nut — BS 3974 come in?
faqs.a: The Bow Nut — BS 3974 is listed in 12 sizes from M8 to M42, with a working load limit of 230 to 7,400 kg. The size table also lists WLL, weight, dimensions C, D, K, M as shown on the drawing.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Bow Nut — BS 3974?
faqs.a: Choose the Bow Nut — BS 3974 on WLL, not on size alone: M8 is rated 230 kg and M42 is rated 7,400 kg. The WLL is for a straight pull along the thread axis. A fully seated shoulder eye takes an angled pull at a reduced rating; a plain eye is for vertical loads only.

faqs.q: What is the working load limit of the Bow Nut — BS 3974?
